_meta.pillar: FHG (For His Grace) + All 864zeros Studio & Media Division Pillars (Sloane Sterling STUDIO-001 · Orion Kai MEDIA-001)
_meta.description: Extensible mapping registry from abstract visual spec IDs to their exact generation prompt templates, negative tokens, Geometry Filter Ladder (G1-G5), Humanizer Filter Ladder (S1-S5), Blotchy Sumi-e Ink-Wash Prepass (B1), Pure-Python Color Printmaking Filter Ladder (C1-C4), and canonical bottom-right signature rules.

cross_division_pipeline_order.scope: Available across ALL 864zeros Studio & Media Division products (FHG Bible Study/Trivia/Journals, Poetry & Creative Books, Editorial Covers, Social/Video Stills)
stages: Stage 0 (Base Generation): jeff_sketch LoRA or base ink-and-wash draft
Stage 1 (Blotchy Prepass · B1): apply_blotch_prepass() — converts translucent washes or contour line clusters into 3-tier sumi-e charcoal brush daubs while clearing outer 5.8% parchment margins
Stage 2 (Geometry Ladder · G1-G5): apply_geometric_transform() — Zhang-Suen 1px skeletonization + RDP straight-chord simplification
Stage 3 (Humanizer Ladder · S1-S5): apply_humanizer_ladder() — feTurbulence nib tooth + anisotropic charcoal diffusion

Stage 4 (Color Printmaking Ladder · C1-C4): apply_color_printmaking_stage() — Pure-Python Risograph angled halftone screens & Ukiyo-e skyline bokashi woodblock layers (or hybrid AI Img2Img prompt templates)
Stage 5 (Canonical Signature Lock): jeff_canonical_signature.png stamped last at bottom-right (width=0.18w, x_right=0.942w, y_bottom=0.971h)

geometry_ladder.algorithm: Zhang-Suen 1px skeletonization + Ramer-Douglas-Peucker (RDP) per-stroke polyline simplification

G4.label: Bold Angular Straight-Edge Strokes (9.5px straight-chord tolerance)

color_printmaking_ladder.algorithm: Morphological 3-tier tonal separation (deep_black, dark_gray, mid_gray, ambient_pool) with MaxFilter(5) anti-alias fringe guard + angled 2D halftone dot matrices (halftone_screen) + automatic skyline Ukiyo-e bokashi gradient (compute_sky_bokashi_mask)

C1.label: Dual-Tone Earth Risograph (Terracotta Clay 35deg & Deep Forest Pine)

C2.label: ★ FAVORITE #1: 3-Color Earth Risograph (Golden Ochre 18deg, Sage Olive 52deg, Terracotta Rust 78deg & Raw Umber)

C3.label: ★ FAVORITE #2: Ukiyo-e Woodblock × Earth-Tone Risograph Hybrid (Framed Terracotta-Amber Skyline Bokashi + 3-Color Earth Risograph)

C4.label: Classic Ukiyo-e Prussian Blue Bokashi + Earthy Woodblock Tints

filter_upstream_source_matrix.description: Canonical upstream input source for each downstream filter variation in the 11-Style FHG Studio Pipeline

✒️ Contour (G2 / _g2_s2.jpg).stage_flag: G2+S2 (or G2+S3 for people from back)
✒️ Contour (G2 / _g2_s2.jpg).reason: Requires pure un-blotched contour line skeleton from _base.jpg so Zhang-Suen skeletonization and RDP 2.5px chiseled chord simplification operate solely on pen lines.

📐 Angular (G4 / _straight_g4.jpg).reason: Requires pure contour line skeleton from _base.jpg to convert curves into 9.5px planar straight-edge architectural segments without wash blotches.

🌲 Terra/Pine (C1 / _c1_riso_terra_pine.j.reason: Separates the 3 tonal ink-wash tiers of the B1 blotchy plate into angled Terracotta Clay (35°) & Sage-Slate (75°) Risograph halftone dot screens while preserving Deep Forest Pine contours.

★ Riso Earth (C2 / _c2_riso_earth.jpg).reason: Separates the B1 blotchy ink-wash daubs into 3-color Earth Risograph halftone screens: Golden Ochre (18°), Sage Olive (52°), and Terracotta Rust (78°) with Raw Umber primary linework.

★ Ukiyo-e (C3 / _c3_ukiyoe_riso.jpg).reason: Uses the B1 top skyline contour ridge for the framed Ukiyo-e bokashi sky gradient and converts the lower B1 ink-wash blotches into 3-color Earth Risograph halftone screens.

🌊 Prussian (C4 / _c4_ukiyoe_prussian.jpg.reason: Applies a top-down Prussian Blue (#183858) Ukiyo-e bokashi woodblock sky fade and tints the B1 ink-wash blotch zones with mineral woodblock pigments.

🌀 Loop Scribble (_loop_scr.jpg).reason: Extracts structural contour from G2/G4 and converts the B1 wash tonal delta into continuous fountain-pen circular coils.

🕸️ X-Hatch (_xhatch_scr.jpg).reason: Extracts structural contour from G2/G4 and converts the B1 wash tonal delta into 3-tier (-48° / -132° / -12°) cross-hatching.

🪄 Subtractive P3 (_sub_scr.jpg).reason: Combines G2 contour search ribbons with darkened found silhouettes and open negative-space erasure from B1.

fhg_sketch_spec.prompt_template: jeff_sketch style, {subject}, authentic freehand black fountain-pen contour drawing on warm cream parchment paper (#F5EFE2). fhg_indigenous_animals_g1_h2_minblotch_s.label: FHG Indigenous Biblical Animals Field Sketch (G1 Freehand + H2/S2 Humanizer + Minimal Blotchy B1-Lite)
fhg_indigenous_animals_g1_h2_minblotch_s.medium: Ultra-sparse single-pass sepia fountain/reed-pen contour (G1) with H2/S2 hand-drawn wrist micro-tremor and 1–2 minimal translucent walnut/earth tea-wash blotches on 70–75% open warm cream parchment (#F5EFE2)
fhg_indigenous_animals_g1_h2_minblotch_s.master_prompt_template: Minimalist hand-drawn biblical field sketch of {subject}. Style & Filter Spec (G1 + H2 + Minimal Blotchy): G1 (Sparse Contour Line): Ultra-simple, single-pass sepia fountain-pen and reed-pen contour line work with open broken-stroke intervals, zero dense cross-hatching, zero fur/feather rendering, and zero heavy shading. H2 (Hand-Drawn Humanizer): Natural human wrist micro-tremor, slight pen-lift hesitation at turns, and tiny organic ink pooling where the nib pauses. Minimal Blotchy Wash (B1-Lite): Only 1 to 2 very light, translucent warm walnut-ink and raw-umber watercolor tea-wash blotches loosely brushed behind the main silhouette with soft water-bloom edges, keeping 70-75% of the warm cream cotton parchment (#F5EFE2) completely untouched. Strict Constraints: Square 1:1 composition, generous negative space around the border, NO human faces, NO text, NO letters, NO signatures, NO watermarks.
fhg_indigenous_animals_g1_h2_minblotch_s.negative_prompt: dense cross-hatching, photorealistic fur or feathers, heavy dark washes, edge-to-edge fill, human faces, text, letters, signatures, watermarks, modern fencing

post_process.blotch_prepass: B1-Lite (Minimal 1-2 translucent sumi-e / walnut wash daubs, 70% open parchment)
post_process.downstream_c1_c4_source: Apply C1, C2, C3, C4 to the B1 (_b1_g2_s2.jpg) plate; apply G2 Contour and G4 Angular directly to the Base (_base.jpg) plate.
